newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's AWB sells 16,000 T wheat in tender 26.
newsitem.headline: Australia's AWB sells 16,000 T wheat in tender 26.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said on Wednesday it sold 16,000 tonnes of wheat in its latest tender for sales from its national pool.

The AWB sold 4,000 tonnes of Australian Standard White (ASW) at A$194.00 a tonne, 6,000 tonnes of ASW at A$193.00 a tonne, 4,000 tonnes of ASW at A$192.00 a tonne and 2,000 tonnes of ASW soft varieties at A$197.00 a tonne.
All sales were for Geelong delivery.
Highest failed bids were at A$190.00 a tonne for ASW Port Kembla and A$191.00 a tonne for ASW Geelong.
Bids for a total of 22,000 tonnes, all for current crop wheat, were received.
